newsitem.title: USA: Great Southern sees $2.6 mln Q1 charge.
newsitem.headline: Great Southern sees $2.6 mln Q1 charge.

text.p: Great Southern Bancorp expects to record $2.6 million in after-tax charges against its fiscal first quarter earnings.

The first of two non-recurring items is a $1.5 million after-tax charge resulting from a one-time assessment imposed by the federal government for the Savings Association Insurance Fund, said the bank holding company.
As a result of this charge, Great Southern expects to see a 70 percent reduction in its future SAIF premiums.
In addition, Great Southern said it wrote off $1.1 million after-tax of excess cost over fair value of net assets acquired related to a 1982 acquisition of a failed thrift.
Finally, the company also said it initiated a buy-back of up to 400,000 shares of its common stock.
